lines: List of Goods and Chattels of William Morgan Deceased :
41 Bs. of white corn at 35 cts.
Straw Bed Tick & 2 feather Beds & Pillers
1 Straw tick 1 check & 1 Goose feather Beds & 7 Pillows
2 large Stone ware Dishes lot of cups & Saucers

We the Subscribers appointed By the Register Appraisers of the Goods and Chattels of William Morgan deceased do on oath respectively say that the goods and Chattels in this inventory have Been appraised By us at the Sum Set Down against the Same respectively and that Said Sums are according to the best of our Skill and Judgement the true value of Said goods and Chattels in money.
Dated the twenty fourth day of April
State of Delaware, Kent County, SS

Minor (?) Conaway Administrator of William Morgan on solemn oath says he has made due and diligent inquiry concerning the goods, chattels and moneys of William Morgan deceased and that this Inventory (unclear) all the goods, chattels and money of said deceased which has come to the Knowledge of this deponent.
Sworn and subscribed this 13th day of July A.D.
Sale List of Personal Property of the Late Wm. Morgan
I hereby certify that the above is a true list of the said sale.
